fab_stackup.name: JLC02101

source.document: Impedance calculator stackup data (the template list of https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-impedance-calculator, read from its public data request; the https://jlcpcb.com/impedance page shows the same list for 1.6 mm); impedance page text; User Guide to the JLCPCB Impedance Calculator
source.notes: Values are the calculator data rows (POST https://jlcpcb.com/api/jlcTools/impedance/selectPageImpedanceDefaultTemplate, the page's own public request, body fields plateLayerNumber and plateThickness; read once per layer count and thickness with a generic client name, no login). Where the impedance page's text and the data disagree the data is used and the page's value is listed under disagreements. Row text is quoted as the data gives it; Chinese labels are kept, with the English the impedance page uses for the same rows in brackets (the bracketed English is the page's, the readings of 成品板厚 and the other Chinese labels are this file's own translation). Re-read before ordering: JLCPCB changes these tables.

nominal.basis: The board thickness option (plateThickness 1) the stackup is listed under in the calculator data; the calculator page names it "Finished Thickness"

layers.name: L1
layers.foil_text: inner copper of the core row (H/HOZ = half ounce)
layers.source: calculator data "JLC02101" (display "JLC02101"), basicDataList row 1 of 1, layerName L1/L2, core "1.5mm 1/1OZ 含铜": topConductorThick 0.03

layers.name: L1/L2
layers.source: calculator data "JLC02101" (display "JLC02101"), basicDataList row 1 of 1, 芯板 "1.5mm 1/1OZ 含铜": dielectricThick 1.43, dielectricConstant 4.42, brand NP-155F

layers.name: L2
layers.foil_text: inner copper of the core row (H/HOZ = half ounce)
layers.source: calculator data "JLC02101" (display "JLC02101"), basicDataList row 1 of 1, layerName L1/L2, core "1.5mm 1/1OZ 含铜": botConductorThick 0.03

fab_stackup.layers_sum_basis: Copper foils and dielectrics exactly as listed, added; soldermask and outer plating are not in the data. The core rows list the dielectric between the core's own copper foils (the core's nominal size in its name includes that copper where it says with copper).

mask.source: impedance page, "2.Solder mask Parameters" (read 2026-11-24); the same four values in the User Guide to the JLCPCB Impedance Calculator, "Calculation Parameters Used" (base soldermask 1.2 mil, copper-surface soldermask 0.6 mil, soldermask between traces 1.2 mil, soldermask dielectric constant 3.8; read 2026-11-24)

flags.note: Flags as the data gives them; JLCPCB does not document them on the pages read. laminationType 1 is the stackup the display name marks 通用 (general) or 免费 (free), 2 the 特殊 (special) or unmarked others.

disagreements: The layers add to 1.49 mm against a nominal 1 mm: the listed core is the same '1.5mm 1/1OZ' core the 1.6 mm two-layer row uses (1.43 mm). Confirm with JLCPCB before relying on it.
notes: Two-layer rows carry no stackup picture on the impedance page (which lists 4 and 6 layers only); this is the order template row. Its copper thickness is the core row's conductor thickness (0.015 mm for an H/HOZ core, 0.030 mm for 1/1OZ), not a finished plated outer thickness.
